programs.name: Panama Stopover
programs.rules: Can be taken on outbound or return segment. Must be booked on original ticket via Stopover engine or Multi-City. Luggage can be checked to final destination or retrieved.

programs.name: Portugal Stopover
programs.rules: Available in Lisbon or Porto. Up to 10 days with 25% discount on domestic flights.

programs.name: Icelandair Stopover
programs.rules: Up to 7 nights in Iceland on transatlantic crossings at no extra airfare.

programs.name: Stopover in Istanbul
programs.rules: Free hotel voucher (1 night economy, 2 nights business) for layovers >= 20 hours.

programs.name: Bogota Connection Stopover
programs.rules: Available on select multi-city fares across South American routes.
